note: Private RV campground on the St. Marys River in downtown Sault Ste. Marie, a short walk from the Soo Locks (watch freighters lock through). Directory listings (not the operator) describe a May-October season, 9 pull-throughs and tight sites where a 23-ft rig fits the pull-throughs and corner sites; a reviewer says there is no website and you call to book. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $40 a night in July 2025 (Campendium review); the park has no web page beyond Facebook (2026-10-22). --Claude
